stories.t: Bangladesh: Sheikh Hasina Extradition and Return Pledge
stories.x: Hindustan Times reported that UK parliamentarians appealed to the Foreign Secretary for safeguards regarding Sheikh Hasina and the death penalty.

stories.t: Russia Hits Ukrainian Infrastructure Ahead of Abu Dhabi Talks
stories.x: United Daily News (Taiwan) reported that Russian and Ukrainian officials held talks in Abu Dhabi mediated by the US, focusing on security guarantees while territorial issues remain a core dispute. Kyiv Independent reported that Ukrainian strikes cut Russia's oil refining capacity by 30% according to Reuters.

stories.t: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Impeachment Effort
stories.x: France 24 reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a move to impeach him by a Republican lawmaker as a farce and a political stunt. United Daily News (Taiwan) reported that US Defense Minister Pete Hegseth called the impeachment initiative a farce and stated that attacking Iran was the right decision after Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie introduced an impeachment

stories.t: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Extramarital Affair and Espionage Claims
stories.x: CBC reported that Nvidia opened an investigation into the CEO's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. ABC Australia reported that Nvidia's value plummeted after news broke of CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

stories.t: Israel: Coalition Formation Talks and Political Transitions
stories.x: RFI reported that former army chief Gadi Eisenkot was given the first chance to form Israel's next government after elections left neither main political bloc with a majority. HuffPost World reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

stories.t: US-Iran Tensions: Regional Diplomacy and Maritime Incidents
stories.x: United Daily News (Taiwan) reported that US President Donald Trump stated the war with Iran is basically over and downplayed concerns about an expanded US offensive. IRNA English, an Iranian state outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps Aerospace Force unveiled a new missile city displaying various advanced missiles.

stories.t: US Military Aircraft Withdrawn from UK Airbase
stories.x: Gazeta Wyborcza reported that American tankers were evacuated from a second base in Britain because of an Iran threat. Politico reported that bombers were withdrawn from RAF Fairford in October after an Iran-linked security incident.

stories.t: France Blames Iran for Supermarket Refrigerator Cyberattack
stories.x: Le Figaro (state-media) reported that Tehran rejected unfounded accusations from France attributing an October cyberattack to an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps cyber unit. Politico reported that Iran denied any role in cyberattacks on French supermarket refrigerators.

stories.t: Senegal migrant boat disaster
stories.x: Aujourd'hui au Faso reported on the tragedy of clandestine emigration from Kébémer. New York Times World reported that a shipwreck off Senegal killed dozens of people while the Canary Islands declared a migrant emergency.

stories.t: Gaza: Severe Storms and Floods Damage Displaced Persons Tents
stories.x: New York Times reported that at least four people from one family were killed and thousands of Palestinians lost their shelters when a storm battered overcrowded tent camps. The Telegraph reported that Gaza floods were warned to be an immediate humanitarian emergency by Trump's Board of Peace.

stories.t: South Africa: ANC Suffers Historic Setback in Municipal Elections
stories.x: RFI reported that the African National Congress took just 30 percent of the votes in local elections, marking its worst electoral performance to date. Daily Maverick reported that the ANC's share of the local vote fell from 47.5% to 32.5%, while the MK entered at 9.9% and the DA rose to 22.9%.

stories.t: Bulgaria Motorway Multi-Vehicle Pile-Up
stories.x: Dnevnik (Bulgaria) reported that the Bulgarian government declared November 11 a day of mourning for the victims of the Trakia motorway pile-ups. BBC reported that at least 11 people died and 46 people were injured in pile-ups in both directions along a section of the Trakia motorway.

stories.t: Malaysia: Najib Razak House Arrest and Ministerial Resignation
stories.x: Al Jazeera reported that a Malaysian court cleared former PM Najib Razak for a house arrest transfer. Reuters reported that a Malaysia court cleared the way for ex-PM Najib to start house arrest, according to Bernama.

stories.t: Poland: Krakow Mass Shooter Dies in Hospital Amid Terrorism Probe
stories.x: The Independent World reported that the suspect’s 21-year-old younger sister, a queer artist, was also killed in the Krakow shooting that left six dead. Rzeczpospolita reported that over 7 million złoty has been raised for Artur Morański and Jakub Kulika, the police officers who immobilized the gunman in Krakow.

stories.t: Indonesia: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resignation and Political Turmoil
stories.x: Antara reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign. Antara reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

stories.t: GCC Approves Unified Military Command Headquarters in Kuwait
stories.x: Asharq News reported that defense ministers of the Gulf Cooperation Council approved the creation of an advanced command for the Unified Military Command in Kuwait. Daily Times (Pakistan) reported that the Gulf Cooperation Council approved a new joint military headquarters in Kuwait and agreed to deploy forces at the facility.

stories.t: Russell Brand Sexual Misconduct Allegations and Sentencing
stories.x: New York Times reported that Jemima Goldsmith accused Russell Brand of violence and coercive control during their relationship. France 24 reported that British comedian and TV star Russell Brand was jailed for more than 10 years for a string of sex offences including rape.

stories.t: DR Congo military court sentences soldiers to death
stories.x: RFI reported that military justice in eastern DR Congo condemned 66 soldiers to death in North Kivu. DW reported that a DR Congo military court sentenced 66 soldiers to death for cowardice in a conflict with M23 rebels.

stories.t: Yemen Conflict: Houthi Drone Attack Damages Riyadh Aramco Tower
stories.x: Mehr News reported that the spokesman for the Yemeni armed forces announced four operations against Saudi Arabia, including targeting an East-West oil pipeline in Riyadh. Asharq News reported that the Yemeni army announced executing 874 air and artillery attacks targeting Houthi positions under the 'Dawn of Yemen' operation.

stories.t: Syria and Jordan Economic and Security Partnership
stories.x: Middle East Monitor reported that Syria's Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani denied reports that Syria reached an agreement with Saudi Arabia to send troops to Yemen. Al-Watan (Syria) reported that former Jordanian Prime Minister Bisher Khasawneh stated Syrian-Jordanian relations are at their best stage in 30 years.

stories.t: South Africa arrests foreign nationals over Russia-Ukraine war
stories.x: RFI reported that South African police announced the arrest of nine Zimbabwean nationals suspected of intending to leave to fight in Ukraine. BBC World reported that nine Zimbabweans were caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine.

stories.t: Viktor Orbán's Brother Arrested in Hungary Amid Human Trafficking Probe
stories.x: RT (state-media) reported that former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban slammed his brother's detention as a government attempt to eliminate the opposition. The Independent World reported that Viktor Orbán stated the target is him after his brother Áron Orbán was detained for suspected human trafficking and corruption.

stories.t: Bangladesh: Sheikh Hasina Extradition and Return Pledge
stories.x: Al Jazeera reported that Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal said ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be executed if she returns home. The Guardian World reported that disgraced former leader Sheikh Hasina plans a return to Bangladesh from exile and is confident she will return despite facing the death penalty.

stories.t: Germany EU Budget Ukraine Support Dispute
stories.x: BILD reported that Slovakia and Czechia are opposing additional Ukraine aid. Moldova news (YAM) reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is urging European Union member states to agree on new financial aid for Ukraine before negotiating the EU's next budget.

stories.t: Greece: Migrant Boat Sinking Off Crete Kills Thirteen
stories.x: Associated Press reported that the death toll from a migrant boat found south of Greece increased to 14. HuffPost World reported that Greek authorities found 12 bodies in a boat carrying migrants south of Crete while a Moroccan-flagged cargo ship rescued 18 people.

stories.t: Kenya methamphetamine seizure
stories.x: Africanews reported that Kenyan authorities seized 454 kilograms of crystal methamphetamine worth $27 million in a multi-agency operation. BBC Africa reported that Kenyan police said investigations into the drug seizure started after a key suspect was arrested in Tanzania.

stories.t: US Supreme Court Border Wall Construction Ruling
stories.x: The Guardian reported that the US Supreme Court allowed Donald Trump's border wall in Texas's Big Bend, ruling that a law enacted by Congress reflects a preference for border control over environmental and recreational harm.

stories.t: Paraguay political and banking crisis
stories.x: Folha de S.Paulo reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected. El Universal (Mexico) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

stories.t: Mali and Guinea gold miners repatriation
stories.x: RFI reported that Mali deplored an unconcerted pushback of gold miners arriving from Guinea and is continuing their care. Aujourd'hui au Faso reported on tension between Conakry and Ouagadougou over the expulsion of Burkinabe gold miners from Guinea.

stories.t: Tanzania: 21 People Perish in a Road Carnage Along Iringa-Mbeya Highway
stories.x: AllAfrica reported that 21 people were killed and five others injured after a Fuso minibus collided with a Scania truck at Kiponzero Junction along the Iringa-Mbeya Highway. According to AllAfrica, President Samia Suluhu Hassan sent a condolence message to Iringa Regional Commissioner Kheri James following the deaths.

stories.t: US Aftermath: Trump Concedes Deportation Policy Was Too Tough
stories.x: New York Times reported that in some states that elected Democrats, voters also approved measures to restrict transgender athletes, require voter identification, and toughen prison sentences.

stories.t: Teddy Riner Announces 2027 French Presidential Candidacy
stories.x: RFI reported that five-time Olympic judo champion Teddy Riner announced he would run in next year's presidential election.

stories.t: Iraq: Khor Mor gas field attacked by drone
stories.x: Al Mada (Iraq) reported that the 'Eco Iraq' observatory stated estimated losses from production halting at the Khor Mor gas field exceed 4.15 million dollars daily.

stories.t: US-Iran Tensions: Regional Diplomacy and Maritime Incidents
stories.x: Al Mada reported that Iraq has entered the regional crisis via high-level mediation between Washington and Tehran (Al Mada (Iraq)). According to Al Mada, US President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance were scheduled to meet with Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani in Washington to discuss truce proposals with Iran (Al Mada (Iraq)).

stories.x: Felesteen reported that Hamas stated the authorities continue to manage and deepen the humanitarian crisis in Gaza through the blockade and war impacts (Felesteen). The National reported on a deadly landslide and warned about winter conditions in Gaza (The National).

stories.t: Israel: Coalition Formation Talks and Political Transitions
stories.x: According to Middle East Monitor, former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak urged Gadi Eisenkot to accelerate efforts to form a new government. The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog warned against the continuation of certain policies during a ceremony to officially task Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government (Naharnet).

The New Arab reported that Jordan's foreign minister visited Damascus for high-level talks following recent Jordanian airstrikes on Syria (The New Arab).

stories.x: Al Mada reported that the Khor Mor gas field was hit by a drone attack causing a fire, damage, and the complete suspension of production operations (Al Mada (Iraq)).
